Q1. What should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or feature — name it. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation — name the page or topic.
C. The repository generally — describe the problem you want addressed.
Q2. What outcome do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific failure — provide the error or an example. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Change a specific behavior — describe the current and desired behavior.
C. Improve a specific quality, such as speed or usability — state the goal.
